title: Versatile habit tracking app
body: I've been using the app for over a year and love it because it's quick and easy to use every day but it offers a ton of options to customize the views and how you use it to fit different needs.

title: The best habit tracker
body: I would recommend the app, because of its simplicity and customization. Besides that support is open to new features and responsive. Great job!

title: Amazing app!
